issuer: Invesco (Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund)
source_kind: issuer_json_api (backs the 'Distributions' table in the product page's 'Yields & Distributions' section; endpoint template taken verbatim from the page's dynamic_table component config, tableVariation='distributions')
fetch_method: curl (default curl User-Agent, headers Accept: application/json, Origin/Referer https://www.invesco.com) through the session sandbox proxy; invesco.com returns HTTP 406 (empty body, Fastly/Varnish) to requests carrying a spoofed Chrome/Firefox User-Agent, both inside and outside the sandbox (one out-of-sandbox retry was made to rule out egress-IP blocking) - default curl UA is served normally
parsing_notes: amount = distributionAmountPerUnit (the page's '$/Share' column), per-share USD cash; pay_date = payDate; recordDate retained only in the raw file. Source had 9 records, 0 duplicate ex-dates (no summing needed), all amounts > 0. Per-type breakdown fields (ordinaryIncome/shortTerm/longTerm/returnOfCapital) are internally inconsistent in the source (e.g. 2023-12-18 returnOfCapitalDistribution=2 vs total 1.74553; 2019-12-23 returnOfCapitalDistribution=1; several rows have all components 0 or null) and were NOT used; total per-share cash is what the fund paid regardless of tax character (return of capital kept). liquidationDistribution is null on every row; no reinvested/undistributed capital gains or stock-split rows are present in the source, so nothing was excluded. The endpoint was called without a date-range parameter and returned records back to 2007-12-17 (fund inception 2007-02-20), i.e. the full since-inception list the page's 'View since inception' option uses; the page component's maxRowCount=10 is a display limit only. Cross-check: issuer Qualified Notice PDFs (invesco.com tax center, 'Invesco DB pools Qualified Notice') independently show UUP ex 2019-12-23 0.52612, ex 2024-12-23 1.31709 (pay 2024-12-27), ex 2025-12-22 0.92686 (pay 2025-12-26) - all match. No 2026 distribution appears in the source through the capture date; UUP distributes yearly in December.
urls_tried: https://www.invesco.com/us/financial-products/etfs/product-detail?audienceType=Investor&ticker=UUP (legacy portal; 406 to browser UAs, redirects to AEM page)
